items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: He and I were still friends up until the time he passed.

ctx.x: And then, I told Joe Glaser about him a month later. Joe sent a letter and a ticket, and also, oh, let me see, about $100 for a little money. But, I kept that month, and I thought it over (inaudible). My aunt told me, she was living in New Jersey, in Newark. I told her I was going to Chicago. I had an opportunity to go to Chicago. So, thought it out. She said you'd better stay there cause she was, and if you're going away, you'd better come to New York. So, in case things don't work out for you, I can kinda help…
said if anytime you want me or need me in New York or anywhere, just let me know. It was very nice of him. He and I were still friends up until the time he passed.
And so, I went to New York with the band. Then, I got a break at the Harlem Opera House.
